name: automated-github-repository-categorization-chrome-extension
description: A Chrome Extension and Flask backend for automated GitHub repository domain classification.

scripts.check: npm run lint:extension && npm run validate:manifest && npm run test:python
scripts.validate:manifest: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path='extension/manifest.json'; JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path,'utf8')); console.log(path + ' is valid JSON');"
